body.title: Implement explicit inactive-record migration and coordinated cutover
body.summary: Migrate supported old inactive records under exact fences; preserve inputs/results/actions and unresolved guards; wire all production consumers to new execution without flags or legacy dual writers.
acceptanceChecks: Interrupted migration never loses proof; old-only rollback rejected after new formats; no automatic scans/resume, no partial daemon deployment or stopped-attempt restart.
Run and record this task's focused validation before advancing; cross-cutting qualification does not replace these checks.

Wire the real production review ownership, both-family checkpoint/native resource, progress, publication, approval and cleanup paths to compact runtime; no test-only adapter or legacy active-writer fallback remains for new execution.

Activate the t7/t8 shared family preparation adapters and t9 host bridge through every production task/story admission, execution, explicit recovery and publication path; remove old active-writer selections in this same cutover. Test-only adapters do not satisfy this task.

tests.name: Proposed migration/cutover tests: inactive v1/v2 byte-preserving upgrade, legacy guards, interrupted migration, unknown capabilities and unsupported old-reader downgrade.
